gate.title: Admin access only
gate.line: These screens are for the clip team (curators and raters). Only a clip-team demo persona has admin access; a signed-in account does not.
gate.mockTitle: Mock mode: choose a demo pseudonym
gate.mockLine: Pseudonyms only, never names. With the real API, the server checks the admin scope on every call.
gate.personaTitle: Demo: act as a clip-team persona
gate.personaLine: Synthetic personas with pseudonyms only, never names. The server checks the admin scope on every call.
gate.personaFailed: Could not start that persona session. It is only available on the demo tenant.

mock.banner: Mock mode: synthetic clips with placeholder media, kept only in this browser. Nothing here is real footage.
mock.source: The admin API is not live yet, so this screen shows mock data from this browser.
mock.ingestLine: In production the clip_ingest workflow transcodes, blurs and flash-checks the upload. In mock mode this button stands in for it.

states.errorTitle: Something went wrong. Nothing you saved is lost.
states.offlineBody: The clip admin needs a connection. Nothing you saved is lost.
states.notFound: There is no clip with this ID.
states.forbidden: Your account can't open this clip.

problem.CLIP_INVALID_TRANSITION: The clip is not at this step any more. Reload to see where it is.
problem.RATING_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: You have already rated this version of the clip.
problem.ADJUDICATOR_IS_RATER: You rated this clip, so someone else has to adjudicate it.
problem.BLUR_AUDIT_FAILED: The blur audit did not pass.
problem.PROHIBITED_FIELD: A text contains personal data (a name, phone number, plate or exact place). Describe what is visible instead.
problem.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
problem.FORBIDDEN: Your account can't do this step.

board.lead: AI-generated clips take a synthetic review; filmed clips take blur and a 100% blur audit. Every clip then needs two blind raters, agreement and a person to publish. AI never publishes.
board.count: {n, plural, =0 {No clips} one {# clip} other {# clips}}
board.emptyLine: Register a clip to start the pipeline.

register.lead: Coarse metadata only: a city, never a street, pin code or coordinates; the month, never a date (NAZAR §4).
register.rawKeyHint: The key of the raw upload in the private bucket.
register.licence: Licence: CC-BY 4.0 for the blurred clip
register.done: Registered as {id}. The ingest workflow has started.

errors.state: Two or three capital letters, for example JK.
errors.city: Letters only, 2 to 60 characters. No street or pin code.
errors.speed: A number from 0 to 150, or choose “not logged”.
errors.duration: Enter the length in seconds, from 1 to 600.

register.durationHint: Only clips of 20 to 60 seconds can be published.

scrubber.label: Clip timeline
scrubber.placeholder: Placeholder clip (mock mode): no real footage yet
scrubber.keys: Keys: , and . step one frame, Space plays or pauses.

audit.lead: Check every frame for a visible face, a legible number plate or other personal information (phone numbers on shop fronts, name boards). Publish needs 100% of frames checked and 0 misses.
audit.noRendition: There is no rendition to audit yet.
audit.playHint: Play at 4× or step through: every frame shown counts as checked.
audit.incomplete: {n} frames not checked yet. You can save a partial audit, but it will not pass.
audit.passed: Audit passed: every frame checked, no misses.
audit.reblur: The missed frames go back to blur as manual masks. The re-blurred clip needs a new audit.
audit.current: Last audit: {checked} of {total} frames, {misses} missed, by {auditor}
audit.aiSkip: AI-generated clips skip the blur audit: there is no real footage to blur. Use the synthetic review instead.

rate.blind: You can't see the other rater's window until you save.
rate.defHazard: Hazard: a road user or condition that would make a careful rider change speed or direction to avoid a conflict.
rate.defOnset: Onset: the first frame at which a careful rider could see that this hazard is developing, not the first frame the object is visible.
rate.defEnd: End: the last frame at which braking or moving over would still comfortably avoid the conflict.
rate.defQuiet: Quiet clip: no hazard by the definition above.
rate.cueHint: What a rider could see, for example “feet at the bus front”. No names or places.
rate.occlusion: The hazard starts hidden behind something
rate.max: Mark at most 10. More than 2 sends the clip to adjudication.
rate.saved: Saved. The other rater's marks show here once both of you have saved.
rate.closed: This clip is not open for rating ({status}).
rate.notRater: Your pseudonym does not have the rater role.

errors.order: The end must be after the onset.
errors.range: Both times must be inside the clip.
errors.cue_pii: The cue contains personal data. Describe what is visible instead.
errors.none: Mark at least one hazard, or choose quiet clip or reject.

agreement.accepted: The raters agree. Final windows are the mean of the two marks.
agreement.refused: The raters disagree, so the clip needs adjudication.

reason.unmatched_hazard: A hazard was marked by only one rater
reason.type_mismatch: The raters chose different hazard types
reason.onset_delta: The onsets are more than 0.5 s apart
reason.end_delta: The ends are more than 1.0 s apart
reason.unconfirmed_proposal: An AI proposal was not confirmed by a rater

adjudicate.lead: Rule on every cluster. A hazard needs your own mark: the final window is the median of the three marks, or the mean of two for a hazard only one rater marked.
adjudicate.notOpen: This clip is not waiting for adjudication ({status}).
adjudicate.isRater: You rated this clip, so someone else has to adjudicate it.
adjudicate.done: Adjudication saved. The clip is rated.

issues.missing_mark: A hazard needs your own mark.
issues.bad_mark: One of your marks is not valid.

cues.lead: One line per hazard in English and Hindi, shown to learners in the replay. Write from the raters' cues; no names or places.
cues.notRated: Cue texts are written once the clip is rated ({status}).
cues.difficultyHint: 1: single hazard, unoccluded, slow, daylight · 3: occlusion, distractor or two hazards far apart · 5: subtle cues, poor light, busy scene.

errors.required: Write both lines, up to 160 characters each.

publish.lead: A person publishes, never AI. Every check must pass.

check.agreement: The raters agree, or an adjudication resolved every hazard
check.blur_audit: Blur audit: 100% of frames checked, 0 misses, on the bytes to publish
check.flash_check: Photosensitivity check passed (no more than 3 flashes a second)
check.cue_texts: Every hazard has a cue in English and Hindi
check.duration: The clip is 20 to 60 seconds long
check.synthetic_review: Synthetic review: every check ticked by a reviewer, with a timestamp

fix.two_ratings: Both raters need to save their windows.
fix.flash_check: The ingest workflow has to pass the flash check.
fix.duration: Re-cut the clip to 20–60 seconds (a new version).
fix.speed: A clip without a logged speed cannot be published.
fix.difficulty: Set the curator difficulty on the cue texts step.
fix.missing_rendition: The ingest workflow has to store the 360p and 480p renditions.

publish.blocked: Publish stays off until every check passes.
publish.done: Published. The clip joins the manifest; raw footage is deleted after the audit.

review.lead: For AI-generated clips instead of the blur audit. Watch the whole clip and tick each check only if it holds for every frame.
review.filmed: This clip was filmed, so it needs the 100% blur audit instead.
review.closed: No clip to review in this status ({status}).

check.no_real_likeness: No real person's likeness (no recognisable face or public figure)
check.no_real_brands: No real brands, logos or shop names
check.no_collision_or_injury: No collision and no injury shown
check.hazard_visible: The hazard is clearly visible as it develops

review.failed: Review saved but not passed: every check must be ticked.

generate.lead: AI-generated practice scenes (Gemini video generation). A generated clip still needs the synthetic review, two blind raters and agreement before it can be published.
generate.scenesMock: Sample scenes (mock): content/nazar/scenes.json is not in the repo yet.
generate.batchHint: Groups clips generated together, for example batch-2026-10-24.
generate.batchError: Letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 40 characters.
generate.started: Generation started as {id}. The job runs in the background.
generate.queued: Generation started (run {run}). The clip appears on the board once the workflow registers it.
